shortTitle: Plan your ride around the wind
title: Plan your ride around the wind
metaTitle: Plan your bike ride around the wind – {name}
description: See headwind, tailwind and crosswind on every segment of your cycling route – at the time you will be there. Free for 3 plans a week.
intro: A weather app tells you the wind in town. Your ride crosses forest, open fields and ridges over several hours. {name} shows the head-, tail- and crosswind on every segment of your route – at the time you'll be there.
ctaLabel: Plan a route in the web app

hero.mainAlt: Wind Flow Map: a route coloured by tailwind, crosswind and headwind
hero.overlayAlt: Tailwind Score with tailwind, crosswind and headwind shares

howImageAlt: Optimal Time Window with a recommended start time

how.title: Time-aware, not a snapshot
how.text: From your start time and speed, {name} calculates when you reach each point and takes the forecast for exactly that hour – coffee stops included.

how.title: Wind where you actually ride
how.text: Forecast wind is measured 10 m up. {name} corrects it to rider height and for the terrain – forest, town or open land.

how.title: Choose the direction that pays off
how.text: Ride your loop clockwise or the other way round, start earlier or later – compare the Tailwind Score and pick the version with the wind at your back on the way home.

ctaTitle: Check the wind on your next route.
